recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-5833 unless the work group later opens a new issue to revise the EpisodeOfCare status set.
issue_request: FHIR-5833 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core PA change request against DSTU1 EpisodeOfCare. It challenged EpisodeOfCare.currentStatus.other as unnecessary because the lifecycle statuses appeared complete, and the final resolution removed other and added waitlist.
initial_application: Git commit 8b7f2a91125c5387861132e44199814238044938, subject 'Tracker# 5206, 5833, 5834 QA/Ballot reconciliation for EpisodeOfCare', appears to be the historical application. Its EpisodeOfCare spreadsheet diff changed the old status list from planned | active | onhold | finished | withdrawn | other to planned | active | onhold | finished | cancelled | waitlist, added the Waitlist concept, and removed the Other concept.
additional_context: EpisodeOfCare is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source uses EpisodeOfCare.status and EpisodeOfCare.statusHistory.status rather than the old currentStatus name. The same historical application commit also handled FHIR-5834's withdrawn-to-cancelled status change, which is already represented on the combined branch by a separate audit commit. FHIR-5206 was part of the same broader EpisodeOfCare status-history reconciliation but does not affect the FHIR-5833 status-code conclusion. Later source evolution added entered-in-error and event-pattern mapping exceptions, but these still list waitlist and do not reintroduce other as an EpisodeOfCare status code. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active EpisodeOfCare StructureDefinition status and statusHistory elements list waitlist and omit other, and the Episode Of Care Status code system defines waitlist without an other concept. Remaining uses of the word other in EpisodeOfCare source are generic prose or mapping text, not the retired status code.

related_jiras.note: The same 2015 EpisodeOfCare reconciliation commit changed withdrawn to cancelled; that neighboring status issue already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
The same historical commit included broader EpisodeOfCare statusHistory clarification, but that issue is not needed to decide whether other was removed and waitlist added.
